# Python.org

> The official home of the Python programming language, providing downloads, documentation, community resources, and governance through the Python Software Foundation.

Python.org serves as the central hub for the Python programming community, offering official releases, comprehensive documentation, and information about the Python Software Foundation. The site connects millions of developers worldwide with resources for learning, contributing, and staying informed about Python's evolution.

## Key Topics

- Python
- CPython
- Python Software Foundation
- Python 3.14.3
- PyPI
- Documentation
- Open-source
- Community
- Release versions
- Getting started
- Web frameworks
- GUI development
- Events
- Job board
- Version management

## Getting Started & Downloads

- [Download Python](https://www.python.org/downloads): Python release versions and download options for all platforms.
- [Python Releases for Windows](https://www.python.org/downloads/windows): Python installers and releases for Windows platforms.
- [Python Releases for macOS](https://www.python.org/downloads/macos): Python installers and releases for macOS platforms.
- [Python Source Releases](https://www.python.org/downloads/source): Python source code releases for versions 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14.
- [Python Releases for Android](https://www.python.org/downloads/android): Python releases and embeddable packages for Android platform.
- [About Python](https://www.python.org/about): Introduction to Python language, applications, and open-source ecosystem.

## Documentation & Reference

- [Official Python Documentation](https://docs.python.org): Official Python 3.14.3 documentation with language reference and API docs.
- [History and License](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html): Python history from Guido van Rossum and licensing information.

## Community & Events

- [Our Community](https://www.python.org/community): Python community overview with channels, events, and diversity information.

## Organization & Governance

- [Welcome to Python.org](https://www.python.org): Official Python.org homepage with news, downloads, and community resources.
- [Python Software Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf): Python Software Foundation overview, grants, membership, and sponsorship info.
